content: {"praised":["Acting is outstanding, especially Viola Davis and the ensemble cast.","Fast pacing keeps the story engaging and suspenseful.","Writing is complex, layered, and keeps characters alive.","Camera work and direction elevate the show beyond typical TV.","Storylines blend romance, murder, and mystery effectively."],"criticized":["Plot becomes predictable after early episodes.","Some scenes require fast forwarding for religious viewers.","Character Asher feels caricatured and one‑dimensional.","Reveals at episode ends lack shock value.","Certain content may be uncomfortable for some audiences."]}
